label: Molecular-sieve dehydration with heat integration
description: Pressure-swing sieves plus heat integration replace azeotropic distillation.

label: Anaerobic digester (component)
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_012
description: Digests manure, crop residues or organic waste to raw biogas.
note: A component: priced only to assemble whole-plant costs with an upgrader (anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading) or an engine (anaerobic-digester_chp) from the same source. Serves no hierarchy node. Added 2026-09-24.

label: Anaerobic digestion with upgrading
description: Digests organic feed to biogas and upgrades it to pipeline-quality gas.
examples-named: RNG plants on landfills and digesters

label: Methanol recovery with heat integration
description: Recovers and recycles methanol with column heat integration or vapour recompression.

label: Distillers-grain drying with heat recovery or heat pumps
description: Recovers dryer exhaust heat, or uses a heat pump, on the largest gas load in the plant.

label: Fermentation CO2 capture and compression
description: Fermentation off-gas is about 99% CO2, so capture is dehydration and compression.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. Biogenic, so it is a removal. The distillation and drying heat is unchanged and still comes from the heat bands.

label: Grain dry-mill fermentation and distillation
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; doe_2015_004; etsap_2013_011
description: Mills, cooks and ferments starch, then distils and dehydrates the beer and dries the stillage.

label: Lignocellulosic enzymatic fermentation
description: Pretreats and enzymatically hydrolyzes biomass before fermentation.

label: Syngas fermentation
description: Microbes convert gasified biomass or waste gas to ethanol.

label: Biomass gasification with methanation
sources: van der Meijden et al 2011; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_012
description: Gasifies solid biomass and methanates the syngas to pipeline-quality gas.

label: Gasification with Fischer-Tropsch synthesis
description: Gasifies biomass or waste and synthesizes liquid hydrocarbons.

label: Landfill gas recovery and upgrading
description: Collects landfill gas and upgrades it to pipeline specification.

label: Alcohol-to-jet
description: Dehydrates and oligomerizes ethanol or isobutanol to jet fuel.

label: Hydrothermal liquefaction
description: Converts wet biomass to bio-crude in hot pressurized water, then upgrades it.

label: Hydrotreating of oils and fats (HEFA/HVO)
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_011
description: Hydrodeoxygenates and isomerizes lipids to diesel and jet range fuels.

label: Methanol-to-jet
description: Converts methanol, including e-methanol, to jet fuel.

label: Pyrolysis oil upgrading
description: Fast pyrolysis of biomass then hydroprocessing of the oil.

label: Biogas upgrader (component)
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_012
description: Removes CO2 and impurities from biogas or landfill gas by water scrubbing, amine, pressure swing adsorption, membranes or organic solvent.
note: The upgrader alone; anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading is digester and upgrader together. Methane slip differs by technology (0.04% amine to 0.5-20% membrane). Added 2026-09-23. Made a component 2026-09-24: an upgrader delivers RNG only with a digester (anaerobic-digester_biomethane-upgrading) or landfill gas (process-improvement_landfill-gas-recovery) behind it, so it serves no hierarchy node.

label: Alkali-catalyzed transesterification
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_011
description: Reacts oils or fats with methanol over a homogeneous catalyst to fatty acid methyl esters.

label: Heterogeneous-catalyst transesterification
description: Solid catalyst avoids the washing and neutralization steps and gives cleaner glycerin.

label: Distillation with mechanical vapour recompression
description: Recompresses overhead vapour to drive the reboiler, cutting steam use.

label: Alkali-activated binder
sources: UKERC 2013; Lehne and Preston 2018; ETSAP I03
description: Geopolymer binder from slag or ash with an alkali activator, without clinker.

label: Blended cement with supplementary cementitious materials
description: Replaces clinker with slag, fly ash or ground limestone.

label: Calcined clay cement (LC3)
description: Clay calcined at about 800 degC replaces part of the clinker.

label: Carbonated binder
description: Calcium silicate binder cured with CO2 rather than water.

label: Electrochemical cement from calcium silicates (Sublime)
description: Electrolysis at ambient temperature extracts calcium from non-carbonate calcium silicates and makes a cementitious binder without a kiln, so there is no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Sublime Systems route (MIT spin-out of Ellis et al. 2019); the IEA guide row on electrolytic limestone decarbonation ahead of a kiln is a different route and is not mapped here. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Hydrothermal calcium hydrosilicate binder
description: Binder made in an autoclave and ground, with no rotary kiln (e.g. Celitement).
note: Rests on one source value. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Calcium sulphoaluminate clinker
description: Clinker based on ye'elimite, fired at about 1250 degC with less limestone.
note: Process CO2 20-50% below Portland clinker. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Electrified or indirectly heated calciner
description: Calcines the meal with electric heat or an indirectly heated vessel, separating process CO2 from flue gas.

label: Ball mill
description: Tumbling mill grinding clinker and additions to cement fineness.

label: Vertical roller mill or high-pressure grinding rolls
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I03; doe_2017_002
description: Bed comminution in place of impact grinding, at much lower specific power.
note: Merged grinding-mill_high-pressure-rolls (High-pressure grinding rolls) 2026-09-23; it had family mining.

label: Portland clinker from calcium-silicate rock (Brimstone)
description: Dissolves calcium-silicate rock instead of limestone and fires the recovered calcium to ordinary Portland clinker, co-producing a supplementary cementitious material and magnesium; no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Dry rotary kiln with preheater and precalciner
carriers: municipal-waste; hydrogen; coal; petroleum-coke; natural-gas; biomass
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; Habert et al 2020; IPCC 2022; Lehne and Preston 2018; ETSAP I03; doe_2017_002
description: Multi-stage cyclone preheater and precalciner ahead of a short rotary kiln, with a grate cooler.

label: Cement kiln with post-combustion capture
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IPCC 2022; ETSAP I03; etsap_2010_007
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 332 (full capture); row 333 gives 8 for partial capture below 50%
description: Amine or solid-sorbent capture on the kiln stack, taking the process and combustion CO2 together.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. The regeneration steam is large enough that the plant needs a heat source of its own, which is the host-side fact this row carries. Oxy-fuel and direct-separation kilns concentrate the stream instead and are their own rows.

label: Cement kiln efficiency measures, moderate
description: Combustion and sealing measures on an existing kiln line.
examples-named: burner and combustion control; reduced false air; kiln shell insulation
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Cement kiln efficiency measures, strong
description: The preheater, cooler and gas-path upgrades that together take a kiln line well below its current fuel use.
examples-named: extra preheater stages; high-efficiency grate cooler; low-pressure-drop gas path
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Fluidized-bed kiln
description: Sinters clinker in a fluidized bed rather than a rotating kiln, at lower temperature.

label: Legacy cement kiln (wet, semi-dry or long dry)
description: Wet, semi-wet, semi-dry (Lepol grate) and long dry rotary kilns: routes older than the preheater-precalciner kiln, using more than 15% more fuel per t clinker.
examples-named: wet, semi-wet, Lepol, wet-precalciner and long dry kilns (ETSAP I03)
note: Still operating in Canada after 2000: two wet kilns in 1999 (NRCan cement benchmark guide, 2001); the 2014 MSAPR RIAS lists wet and long dry kilns among Canada's kiln types.

label: Oxy-fuel kiln
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; ETSAP I03
description: Fires on oxygen and recycled flue gas, so the kiln gas is CO2-rich.
note: Oxy-firing concentrates the kiln gas, so the capture plant is the one on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated and is not repeated here; the air separation unit is the host-side cost.

label: Autothermal reforming with full capture
description: Oxygen-blown reforming designed for high capture rates.
note: The oxygen-blown route gives one concentrated stream, held on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated; there is no dilute flue gas to treat separately.

label: Fired heater and distillation train
description: Reboilers and fired heaters driving separation columns.

label: Heat-integrated, progressive or divided-wall distillation
description: Column internals and heat integration cutting reboiler duty against a conventional train.
note: Merged distillation-column_progressive (Progressive or divided-wall distillation) 2026-09-23; it had family petroleum-refining, trl 8.

label: Heat-pumped distillation
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Kiss et al 2012
description: Vapour recompression or a closed-cycle heat pump replaces the reboiler steam.

label: Membrane chlor-alkali cell
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Chlor-alkali BREF 2014; van 2025
description: Ion-exchange membrane cell producing chlorine, caustic soda and hydrogen.

label: Oxygen-depolarized cathode cell
description: Feeds oxygen to the cathode, cutting cell voltage and power use, with no hydrogen co-product.

label: Sodium chlorate cell
description: Electrolytic cell making sodium chlorate for pulp bleaching.

label: Biomass gasification to ammonia (whole plant)
description: Gasifies biomass to syngas, shifts and cleans it to hydrogen and synthesises ammonia.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Ethylene from lignocellulosic gasification
description: Gasifies lignocellulosic biomass to syngas and converts it to ethylene (via methanol-to-olefins or Fischer-Tropsch).

label: Biomass or waste gasification to methanol
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_007
description: Gasifies biomass or waste to syngas, then synthesizes methanol.

label: Coal gasification to ammonia (whole plant)
description: Gasifies coal with oxygen, shifts and cleans the syngas and synthesises ammonia.
note: About 36 GJ/t and 3.2 t CO2/t against 28 GJ/t and 1.8 t for steam reforming (IEA 2021). No Canadian stock. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Nitric acid oxidation adipic acid plant
description: Cyclohexanol and cyclohexanone oxidized with nitric acid, releasing N2O in the off-gas.

label: Anthraquinone hydrogen peroxide plant
description: Hydrogenation and air oxidation of an anthraquinone working solution, with extraction and distillation of hydrogen peroxide.

label: Catalytic N2O abatement
description: Secondary or tertiary catalyst destroying N2O in nitric and adipic acid plants.
note: Abates process emissions rather than energy.

label: Chemical depolymerization
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Uekert et al 2023
description: Depolymerizes PET or polystyrene back to monomer.

label: CO2-to-methanol
sources: IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; etsap_2013_007
description: Hydrogenates captured CO2 to methanol, directly or through reverse water-gas shift.

label: Bio-ethanol dehydration to ethylene
sources: UKERC 2013; IEA ETP Guide 2024; Negri 2021; etsap_2013_009
description: Dehydrates ethanol to ethylene, bypassing cracking.

label: Ethylene oxide and glycol plant
description: Silver-catalysed oxidation of ethylene to ethylene oxide, with hydration to ethylene glycol; separates a nearly pure CO2 stream.
note: The by-product CO2 is concentrated (capture needs only drying and compression). Added 2026-09-25.

label: Electrolytic-hydrogen Haber-Bosch
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Smith et al 2020; iea_2021_001
description: Electrolysis replaces the reformer; synthesis is unchanged.

label: Haber-Bosch synthesis loop with air separation (component)
sources: Armijo and Philibert 2020; Philibert 2017a; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 renewable fuels
description: The ammonia synthesis loop and nitrogen supply, priced without the hydrogen plant.
note: A component: combined with the same source's electrolyser into reactor_haber-bosch-electrolytic. Serves no hierarchy node. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Low-pressure Haber-Bosch
description: Synthesis loop at lower pressure, better matched to variable electrolytic hydrogen.

label: Methanol to olefins
description: Converts methanol to ethylene and propylene over a zeolite catalyst.

label: Ammonia oxidation nitric acid plant
sources: UKERC 2013; MIDDEN database v0.4a; EPA 2010 nitric acid; doe_2015_004
description: Ostwald process: ammonia burned over platinum gauze and the gases absorbed in water; the reaction heat raises export steam.

label: Plastics pyrolysis recycling
description: Pyrolyzes mixed plastic waste to a cracker feedstock.

label: Polymerization reactor and extrusion
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Neelis 2008; Negri 2021; doe_2015_004
description: Reactor trains and extruders making polymers and compounds.

label: Polymerization and extrusion efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice polymerization trains and extruders saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket: DOE state-of-the-art tiers 21-83% below current typical (HDPE, LDPE, PP, PVC, PET, PC, PS). Added 2026-09-25.

label: Syngas methanol synthesis
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; doe_2015_004; etsap_2013_007
description: Reformed gas converted to methanol over a copper catalyst.

label: Thermal N2O destruction
description: Adipic acid off-gas burned or thermally decomposed, destroying N2O and raising steam from the heat.
note: Abates process emissions rather than energy.

label: Urea synthesis and finishing
description: Reacts ammonia with CO2 from the ammonia plant to urea, with prilling or granulation.
note: Consumes ammonia-plant process CO2 (about 0.73 t CO2/t urea), which matters to ammonia capture accounting. Serves chemicals.product.urea, added to the snapshot 2026-09-30. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Catalytic cracking of naphtha
description: Catalysis lowers the cracking temperature against a thermal cracker.

label: Steam cracker with capture on the furnace flue gas
description: Capture on the cracking furnace stacks, which are numerous and dilute.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. Oxy-fuel cracking (iea_2024_001 row 226, TRL 5) concentrates it instead.

label: Electrified cracker furnace
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; Layritz et al 2021
description: Electric heating of the cracking coils in place of burners.
examples-named: BASF, SABIC and Linde demonstration at Ludwigshafen (4 t/h, 6 MW, 2024)

label: Fired tubular steam cracker
carriers: oil; coal; methanol; biomass; steam; hydrogen; natural-gas; naphtha
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA 2018a; IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Neelis 2008; Layritz et al 2021; doe_2015_004
description: Hydrocarbon feed cracked in fired tubular coils, then quenched and separated.

label: Steam cracker efficiency measures, moderate
carriers: oil; coal; methanol; biomass; steam; hydrogen; natural-gas; naphtha
description: The fired tubular steam cracker with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: dividing-wall debutanizer/depropanizer; hybrid membrane-distillation for ethylene/ethane and butadiene separation (UKERC CH-SC1 to CH-SC3)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on steam-cracker_fired-tubular.

label: Rotodynamic cracking reactor
description: Rotating machine heating the process gas directly with electricity.

label: Steam reforming with Haber-Bosch synthesis
sources: Bataille 2017; IEA 2018a; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Smith et al 2020; doe_2015_004; iea_2021_001
description: Reformed natural gas feeds ammonia synthesis at pressure.

label: Ammonia plant with capture on the process CO2
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 347 (partial capture); row 346 gives 6 for full capture
description: The CO2 removal step ahead of synthesis already delivers a pure stream; capture is dehydration and compression, and part of it is already sold for urea.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. This is the cheapest capture in the sector and should not be averaged with flue-gas capture. Full capture needs a second, dilute plant on the reformer flue gas.

label: Ammonia plant efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice reforming, synthesis and heat integration in an ammonia plant, saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket: DOE state of the art 46% below current typical. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Caustic evaporation with mechanical vapour recompression
description: Recompresses vapour in place of multiple-effect steam evaporation.

label: Pressure or vacuum swing adsorption
description: Adsorbent beds separating CO2 from hydrogen-plant syngas.

label: Advanced low-energy solvent
description: Second-generation solvents cutting reboiler duty against first-generation MEA.

label: Amine post-combustion capture
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; Habert et al 2020; IPCC 2022; Leeson et al 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2024 CCTS; Hughes 2023; Hasanbeigi 2013; IEAGHG 2018; Onarheim et al 2017a; Onarheim et al 2017b; etsap_2010_007; iea_2021_001; netl_2022_001
description: Absorbs CO2 from flue gas into an amine solvent; steam strips it back out.
examples-named: Boundary Dam (Cansolv); Entropy Glacier; Brevik cement
note: TRL 9 in power, 7-8 on cement kilns.

label: Calcium looping
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; Leeson et al 2017
description: Lime carries CO2 between a carbonator and a calciner, with high-grade heat recovery.

label: Chemical solvent on process gas
sources: Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; Leeson et al 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Hughes 2023; netl_2022_001
description: Amine absorption on shifted syngas or acid gas, then regeneration.

label: Cryogenic separation
description: Condenses CO2 from a pressurized stream at low temperature.

label: Cryogenic post-combustion capture
description: Chills flue gas so CO2 desublimates or condenses out.

label: Liquid-solvent DAC
sources: Fasihi et al 2019; IPCC 2022; DEA 2024 CCTS
description: Alkaline solution captures CO2; a high-temperature calciner regenerates it.

label: Solid-sorbent DAC
sources: Fasihi et al 2019; DEA 2024 CCTS; Layritz et al 2021
description: Sorbent beds cycled at low temperature, suited to waste heat and modular build.
examples-named: Climeworks; Deep Sky Alpha (Innisfail, Alberta, operating since August 2025)

label: Physical solvent
description: Selexol or Rectisol absorption at pressure on gasifier syngas.

label: Solid sorbent capture
description: Structured adsorbent beds cycling on temperature or pressure, with lower heat demand.

label: Dehydration and compression
sources: IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2024 CCTS; Hughes 2023; Onarheim et al 2017b; netl_2022_001
description: Dries and compresses an already pure CO2 stream for transport.
examples-named: Alberta Carbon Trunk Line: Nutrien Redwater fertilizer plant; ethanol plants

label: CO2 pipeline transport
description: Compression and pipeline transport of captured CO2 to a storage or EOR site.
note: Complement to well_co2-storage at the transmission nodes: each tonne needs both; they are not alternatives. Sources price it per tonne (cost-levelized) or per km of pipe. Added 2026-09-25.

label: CO2 injection and geological storage
description: Injection of CO2 into deep saline formations, depleted fields or oil fields (EOR), with monitoring.
note: Complement to pipeline_co2 at the transmission nodes; not an alternative to it. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Absorption chiller
description: Heat-driven cycle using waste heat or steam instead of electricity.

label: High-efficiency chiller
description: Variable-speed or magnetic-bearing centrifugal machine, often on natural refrigerants.

label: Vapour-compression chiller or refrigeration plant
description: Electric compressor cycle delivering chilled water, brine or refrigeration.

label: Washing and clean-in-place system
description: Product and container washing and clean-in-place systems on site hot water and steam.
note: Conventional host for cleaning-system_efficiency-moderate. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Clean-in-place efficiency measures, moderate
description: Recovery and control on cleaning and clean-in-place systems, which carry much of a plant's hot-water load.
examples-named: final-rinse reuse; heat recovery from CIP returns; cycle time and temperature optimization
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. The roster carries a moderate and a strong cleaning bucket; both sit here until a source separates them.

label: Direct-fired spray, drum or belt dryer
description: Hot gas drying liquids, solids and grain.

label: Food and beverage evaporators
description: Multiple-effect or mechanical-vapour-recompression evaporators concentrating milk, juice or corn steepwater.
note: Type reference: kept for the numbers, not linked to the CIMS hierarchy, which does not resolve food preparation steps (modeller). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Aseptic and UHT processing
description: Short high-temperature treatment with regeneration, in place of in-container sterilizing.

label: Steam-heated kettles, retorts and plate heat exchangers
description: Jacketed vessels, retorts and plate pasteurizers on site steam and hot water.
note: product-unit t (changed from m3 2026-09-26, modeller): its end use is measured in t product; sources priced per m3 of liquid are converted only where a density factor names them.

label: Steam-heated thermal processing efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice steam-heated kettles, retorts, blanchers and vats: heat recovery, insulation, controls and process redesign saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket (design doc s2): DOE state-of-the-art tiers 20-76% below current typical. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Heat pump for hot water and clean-in-place
description: Heat pump supplies wash, CIP and low-temperature process water.

label: Dryer exhaust heat recovery and recirculation
description: Recovers exhaust heat and recycles part of the drying air.
note: Merged heat-recovery-unit_dryer (Dryer heat recovery) 2026-09-23; it had family mining.

label: Oven or dryer exhaust heat recovery
description: Recovers oven and fryer exhaust heat to make-up air or process water.
note: Merged heat-recovery-unit_oven-dryer (Oven and dryer heat recovery) 2026-09-23; it had family other-industry.

label: Ohmic, microwave or infrared heating
description: Heats the product directly, without a steam loop.

label: Bakery oven efficiency measures, moderate
description: The direct-fired tunnel or deck oven with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: burner combustion control and firing-rate modulation, maintenance, heat-transfer optimisation, lighter baking tins (UKERC FD-B1, B2, B11, B12, B13, B25)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on oven_tunnel-deck.

label: Electric oven, fryer or roaster
description: Resistance elements in place of burners.

label: Indirect-fired oven
description: Radiant tubes or heat exchangers keep combustion products out of the chamber.
note: product-unit t: its UKERC source prices it per t of product.

label: Direct-fired tunnel or deck oven
description: Burners firing into the baking chamber.

label: Regenerative heat recovery on pasteurizers
description: Product-to-product regeneration recovering most of the heating duty.
note: product-unit m3 (2026-09-23): its UKERC dairy examples are all priced per m3 of milk.

label: High-pressure processing
description: Non-thermal pasteurization by pressure rather than heat.

label: Microwave or radio-frequency assisted baking
description: Volumetric heating shortens the bake and cuts oven length.

label: Microwave, radio-frequency or vacuum drying
description: Volumetric drying for finishing and low-moisture duties.
note: Merged radio-frequency-heater_vacuum-drying (Radio-frequency or vacuum drying) 2026-09-23; it had family other-industry, type prospective, trl 7.

label: Anaerobic digestion with engine CHP (whole plant)
description: A digester and a biogas engine generating power, with the engine heat recovered as hot water or low-pressure steam.
note: Whole-plant archetype: the alternative to the anaerobic-digester component plus reciprocating-engine_chp. Its input flow is the organic feedstock, never purchased biogas, since the digester is inside its cost. Electricity is an output flow. Added 2026-09-24.

label: Boiler or CHP with post-combustion capture
carriers: biomass; natural-gas; coal; nuclear; by-product-gas; oil; biogas
description: A boiler or CHP unit with a capture plant on the flue gas or exhaust; the regeneration steam is drawn from the unit itself.
note: [heat-low-temp] Flue gas is dilute, so the capture plant is the one on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse and its cost and energy are not repeated here. The steam taken for regeneration is the host-side penalty and belongs on this row. Biomass firing makes it a removal. [heat-medium-temp] Flue gas is dilute, so the capture plant is the one on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse and its cost and energy are not repeated here. Regeneration steam at 120-150 degC competes with the medium-temperature duties this band serves. Merged combined-cycle_ccs-diffuse (CHP with post-combustion capture) 2026-09-30; it had type prospective, trl 8.

label: Electric boiler
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 process heat; CAELP/E3 2024; Rissman 2022; Rissman and Gimon 2023; Haque 2023; LBNL 2021; RTC 2023
description: Resistance or electrode boiler raising hot water or steam at about 99% efficiency.
note: Merged boiler_electric-injection-steam (Electric steam generation) 2026-09-23; it had family oil-and-gas, type prospective, trl 7, product-unit m3.

label: Fuel-fired boiler or thermal-oil heater
carriers: natural-gas; oil; by-product-gas; hydrogen; ammonia; biomethane
sources: Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 process heat; CAELP/E3 2024; Rissman 2022; Rissman and Gimon 2023; Haque 2023; Worrell 2010; LBNL 2021; RTC 2023; Zuberi 2022; ETSAP I01
description: Fire-tube or water-tube boiler raising hot water or steam, or a fired heater circulating thermal oil at 200-400 degC.
note: Merged direct-heater_thermal-oil (Thermal-oil heater) 2026-09-30; it had type conventional, trl 9.

label: Efficient fuel-fired boiler
carriers: natural-gas; oil; by-product-gas; hydrogen; ammonia; biomethane
description: The fuel-fired boiler with efficiency measures applied, including condensing operation where the return water is cold enough.
examples-named: boiler improvement to 80% and to 85% efficiency (UKERC ST-B1, ST-B2)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on boiler_fuel-fired. Merged boiler_condensing (Condensing boiler) 2026-09-30; it had type efficient variant, trl 9.

label: Solid-fuel boiler
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 process heat; EPA 2007; ETSAP I01
description: Grate or fluidized-bed boiler firing solid fuels.

label: Gas-turbine CHP (simple or combined cycle)
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; EPA 2017; EPA 2007; US 2010; Khrushch 1999; etsap_2010_004
description: Turbine exhaust raises process steam in an HRSG; in combined cycle a steam turbine sits between the HRSG and the process.
note: [heat-low-temp] CHP: the heat is the service and the electricity a co-product (design doc D1). Moved off the retired chp end use, 2026-09-14. Merged combined-cycle_cogeneration (Cogeneration supplying steam and power) 2026-09-23; it had family oil-and-gas, type alternative, product-unit m3. Merged combined-cycle_chp (Combined-cycle CHP) 2026-09-30; it had type conventional, trl 9.

label: Direct-fired air or water heater
carriers: natural-gas; hydrogen; biomethane; biogas; liquid-biomass; lpg; oil
description: Burner heating air or water directly for washing, drying and space duties.
examples-named: make-up air heaters, direct-contact water heaters

label: Fired heater or furnace with post-combustion capture
description: Capture plant on the flue gas of a fired heater or furnace; the delivered duty is unchanged and the regeneration steam is imported.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. What holds this back is the number of small stacks, not the chemistry.

label: Fired heater efficiency measures, moderate
description: Combustion and recovery measures on an existing fired heater or boiler plant.
examples-named: combustion-air preheat; oxygen trim and burner control; economizer; insulation and steam-trap programs
note: [heat-low-temp] Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Fired heater efficiency measures, strong
description: Air preheat taken to recuperation or regeneration, with the heater train integrated.
examples-named: recuperative or regenerative burners; condensing economizer; pinch-designed preheat train
note: [heat-low-temp] Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Electric process heater
description: Resistance heater raising a gas or liquid stream in place of a fired heater.

label: Fired process heater
carriers: oil; biomethane; natural-gas; biogas; hydrogen; liquid-biomass; lpg
description: Direct-fired heater raising a process stream, as in refinery charge heaters and dryers.

label: Fired furnace or process heater
carriers: natural-gas; ammonia; hydrogen; oil; biogas; liquid-biomass; lpg
sources: Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Neelis 2008
description: Burner-fired furnace or heater above 400 degC, separable from the process unit.

label: Rotodynamic heater
description: Rotating machine converting electricity to heat in a gas stream at furnace temperatures.
examples-named: Coolbrook RotoDynamic Heater (over 1,000 degC in pilot, Brightlands Chemelot)

label: Solid-fuel direct heater
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 process heat
description: A fired heater or furnace burning coal, coke, biomass or coal tars, with the fuel handling and firing equipment they need.
note: Split from the gas- and liquid-fired heaters: UK TIMES costs solid-fuel units at 5-10 times the gas-fired unit. Coal tars are grouped here because UK TIMES costs them as coal.

label: Solid-fuel direct heater efficiency measures, strong
description: The solid-fuel direct heater with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: UK TIMES advanced solid-fuel direct heaters (Bataille 2017)
note: Added 2026-09-23, split from direct-heater_efficiency-strong by fuel handling.

label: Fuel-cell CHP
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IPCC 2022; EPA 2017; EPA 2007; etsap_2013_004
description: Solid-oxide or molten-carbonate cell producing power and usable heat.
note: [heat-low-temp] CHP: the heat is the service and the electricity a co-product (design doc D1). Moved off the retired chp end use, 2026-09-14.

label: Regenerative or oxy-fuel burner furnace
description: Preheats combustion air, or fires on oxygen, cutting flue-gas losses.

label: Biomass gasifier CHP
description: Gasifier feeding an engine or turbine, with heat recovery.
note: [heat-low-temp] CHP: the heat is the service and the electricity a co-product (design doc D1). Moved off the retired chp end use, 2026-09-14.

label: Geothermal heat
description: Heat drawn from geothermal wells: hot water from a natural aquifer (direct use) or fluid circulated through stimulated hot rock (enhanced systems).
note: No source costs yet. Added 2026-09-25. Merged geothermal-well_direct-use (Geothermal direct use) 2026-09-30; it had type prospective, trl 8.

label: Industrial heat pump or vapour recompression
sources: UKERC 2013; IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; Philibert 2017a; MIDDEN database v0.4a; DEA 2026 process heat; CAELP/E3 2024; Rissman 2022; Rissman and Gimon 2023; ETSAP I07; Haque 2023; Negri 2021; RTC 2023; Zuberi 2022; Zuberi 2023; etsap_2013_002
description: Closed-cycle heat pump or mechanical vapour recompression lifting waste or ambient heat to hot water or process steam, up to about 200 degC.
examples-named: ammonia and CO2 heat pumps on washing and drying duties; Heaten HeatBooster (180 degC steam, Suedzucker 2025); MVR evaporators and dryers
note: Closed-cycle units are commercial to about 150-165 degC; steam-generating units to about 200 degC are nearer TRL 7-8. Merged heat-pump_steam-generating (Steam-generating heat pump or vapour recompression) 2026-09-30; it had type alternative, trl 7-9.

label: Induction heating
description: Induces eddy currents in the workpiece; for conductive materials.

label: Electric arc or plasma heating
description: Arc or plasma torch heating a gas or charge to very high temperature.

label: Electromagnetic heating (microwave, radio-frequency, infrared)
description: Heats the product itself rather than the surrounding air; used in drying and curing.

label: High-temperature gas-cooled reactor
description: Small modular reactor delivering high-temperature steam or process heat.
examples-named: Dow Seadrift with X-energy Xe-100 (construction permit under review)

label: Small modular reactor CHP
description: Reactor supplying process steam and electricity to an industrial site.

label: Reciprocating engine CHP
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; EPA 2017; EPA 2007; etsap_2010_004
description: Engine generator with jacket and exhaust heat recovery, at small scale.
note: [heat-low-temp] CHP: the heat is the service and the electricity a co-product (design doc D1). Moved off the retired chp end use, 2026-09-14.

label: Electric resistance furnace
description: Resistance elements heating the charge or chamber directly.

label: Solar thermal
description: Flat-plate, evacuated-tube or concentrating (parabolic trough, linear Fresnel) collectors raising hot water, steam or thermal oil.
note: Merged solar-concentrator_thermal (Concentrating solar thermal) 2026-09-30; it had type prospective, trl 7-9.

label: Concentrating solar for high-temperature heat
description: Solar tower or dish concentrating to furnace temperatures.

label: Back-pressure or extraction steam turbine
carriers: biomass; coal; municipal-waste; steam; natural-gas; oil; black-liquor; by-product-gas
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; EPA 2017; EPA 2007; ETSAP I07; etsap_2010_004; etsap_2010_005
description: Boiler raises high-pressure steam; the turbine passes it to process at lower pressure.
note: [heat-low-temp] CHP: the heat is the service and the electricity a co-product (design doc D1). Moved off the retired chp end use, 2026-09-14.

label: Electric thermal energy storage
sources: DEA 2026 energy storage; CAELP/E3 2024; Rissman and Gimon 2023; RTC 2023
description: Electrically charged solid or salt store discharging steam, decoupling heat from power prices.
examples-named: Rondo (100 MWh, >100 bar steam, California, October 2025); Kraftblock; Antora; Rondo

label: Waste-heat recovery and heat-charged storage
sources: Bataille 2017; DEA 2026 energy storage; ETSAP I07; etsap_2013_005
description: Economizers and heat exchangers recovering heat from flue gas or process streams, and sensible or latent stores charged with that heat and discharged to a heat demand.
note: Storage costs are add-on (incremental) costs, pooled only with a base system cost from the same source. Added 2026-09-26. Merged heat-recovery-unit (Waste-heat recovery unit) 2026-09-30; it had type conventional, trl 9.

label: Pipeline compression and transmission
description: Compressors moving hydrogen through a dedicated pipeline to industrial users.

label: Solid-oxide electrolysis
description: High-temperature steam electrolysis with higher electrical efficiency.

label: Biomass or waste gasification
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a
description: Gasifies biomass or waste to syngas for fuels or hydrogen.

label: Gasification with capture on the shift gas
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 277 (biomass-waste gasification with CCUS); row 280 gives 9 for coal gasification at partial capture rates
description: Gasifier with a shift reactor and physical-solvent capture, giving one concentrated stream; biomass or waste feed makes it a removal.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated.

label: Hydrogen liquefaction and road transport
description: Liquefies hydrogen for trucking where there is no pipeline; liquefaction takes about a third of the hydrogen's energy.

label: Blending into the natural gas network
trl-basis: assessed; blending trials at 5-20% by volume
description: Injects hydrogen into the existing gas system at a limited volume share, delivering it to users as a blended fuel.

label: Methane pyrolysis
sources: Amin et al 2011; IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; iea_2021_001
description: Splits methane into hydrogen and solid carbon, with no CO2 to capture.

label: Cryogenic air separation unit
description: Distils liquefied air into oxygen, nitrogen and argon at large scale.
examples-named: on-site ASUs at steelworks and smelters

label: Membrane separation
description: Polymer membranes producing nitrogen or oxygen-enriched air.

label: Batch (bell) annealing
description: Coils annealed under a hood in a protective atmosphere over long cycles.

label: Continuous annealing line
description: Strip annealed in line at high speed rather than in batches.

label: Hydrogen bell annealing
description: 100% hydrogen atmosphere improves heat transfer and shortens the cycle.

label: Basic oxygen furnace
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I02; Worrell 2010; US 2012; doe_2015_001
description: Blows oxygen through hot metal to burn out carbon; scrap is the coolant.

label: Basic oxygen furnace efficiency measures, moderate
description: Drive and control measures on the converter and its gas-cleaning plant.
examples-named: variable-speed drives on fan motors; improved gas cleaning; lining and ladle management
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Basic oxygen furnace efficiency measures, strong
description: Recovering the converter gas and its sensible heat instead of flaring it.
examples-named: converter gas collection and use; sensible heat recovery on the off-gas hood
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Blast furnace
sources: Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; Philibert 2017a; MIDDEN database v0.4a; IEA 2020; ETSAP I02; Hasanbeigi 2013; Worrell 2010; US 2012; Hasanbeigi 2014; doe_2015_001
description: Coke-based counter-current shaft reducing iron ore to hot metal, with hot stoves.
examples-named: Stelco Lake Erie; ArcelorMittal Dofasco BF2 and BF4 (retirement scheduled 2030)

label: Blast furnace with post-combustion capture
description: Capture on the blast-furnace gas, or on the stoves and power plant that burn it.
note: Blast-furnace gas is about a fifth CO2, so this is the dilute plant on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. Top-gas recycling concentrates the stream instead and is its own row.

label: Blast furnace efficiency measures, moderate
description: Incremental measures on an existing blast furnace, each worth a few per cent of fuel.
examples-named: top-pressure recovery turbine; improved burden distribution; higher pulverized coal injection; dry gas cleaning
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Blast furnace efficiency measures, strong
description: Heat recovery off the stoves and the slag, the measures the roster separates as the strong bucket.
examples-named: hot stove waste-heat recovery; slag heat recovery; top-gas heat recovery
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Top-gas recycling oxygen blast furnace
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I02; Hasanbeigi 2013; etsap_2010_007
description: Oxygen blast with CO2 stripped from the recycled top gas, which also concentrates the CO2.
note: Recycling concentrates the top gas, so capture sits on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated rather than the dilute plant a conventional blast furnace needs.

label: Continuous casting
description: Casts liquid steel into slabs, blooms or billets in a continuous strand.

label: Ingot casting
description: Casts into ingots, reheated in soaking pits before rolling.
note: Legacy route; CIMS keeps it for the remaining stock.

label: Strip casting
description: Casts near-net-shape strip directly from liquid steel.
note: No Canadian stock.

label: Electrolytic coating line
description: Electro-galvanizing and tin plating from solution.

label: Hot-dip galvanizing line
description: Strip heated and passed through a molten zinc bath.

label: By-product coke oven battery
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I02; Hasanbeigi 2013; Worrell 2010; Asia 2010; US 2012; doe_2015_001
description: Slot ovens carbonizing coal, with the gas cleaned and recovered as coke-oven gas and chemicals.
examples-named: ArcelorMittal Dofasco coke plant (Hamilton); Algoma ovens decommissioned January 2026

label: Coke oven efficiency measures, moderate
description: Battery housekeeping and control, each worth a few per cent of heating fuel.
examples-named: reduced air leakage; battery insulation; heating control and pressure regulation
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Coke oven efficiency measures, strong
description: Recovering the heat now lost in quenching and in the raw gas, the measures the roster files as the strong bucket.
examples-named: coke dry quenching; coke-oven gas sensible-heat recovery
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. Dry quenching raises steam and cuts coke breeze, and is the measure this bucket is usually named for.

label: Heat-recovery coke oven
description: Non-recovery ovens burning the volatiles on site and raising steam for power.
note: No Canadian stock.

label: Electric arc furnace
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Vogl et al 2018; ETSAP I02; Hasanbeigi 2013; Worrell 2010; US 2012; doe_2015_001
description: Melts scrap or DRI with graphite electrodes, with oxy-fuel burners and chemical energy.
examples-named: Algoma (first EAF July 2025, second in 2026); ArcelorMittal Dofasco; Gerdau Whitby

label: High-efficiency EAF
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; Hasanbeigi 2013; Worrell 2010; Asia 2010; doe_2015_001
description: Ultra-high power with scrap preheating or continuous charging, cutting electricity and tap-to-tap time.

label: Low-temperature iron electrowinning
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; Philibert 2017a; MIDDEN database v0.4a; IEA 2020; Humbert et al 2024
description: Dissolves ore in an aqueous electrolyte and plates out iron near ambient temperature.

label: Molten oxide electrolysis
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; IEA 2020; Hasanbeigi 2013; Hasanbeigi 2014; Humbert et al 2024
description: Electrolyzes iron oxide above 1,500 degC, giving liquid iron and oxygen.

label: Gas fermentation of steel off-gases to ethanol
description: Microbial fermentation of CO-rich steel-mill off-gas to ethanol (e.g. LanzaTech).
note: A utilisation alternative to capture on the steel mill's off-gas. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Ladle metallurgy furnace
description: Arc-heated ladle station for alloying, desulphurization and temperature control.

label: Reheating furnace, fuel-fired
description: Walking-beam or pusher furnace heating semis to about 1,200 degC before rolling.

label: Reheating furnace efficiency measures, moderate
description: Control and insulation measures on an existing reheating furnace.
examples-named: oxygen and air-flow control; increased insulation; scheduling and skid design
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Reheating furnace efficiency measures, strong
description: Combustion air preheated against the flue gas, taken to recuperation or regeneration.
examples-named: recuperative burners; regenerative burners; furnace sealing and insulation package
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. Hot charging is the other measure the roster files as strong; it is its own row here because it depends on the caster and mill being coupled.

label: Induction reheating
description: Electric induction heaters in place of, or boosting, a fired reheating furnace.

label: Induction strip heating
description: Induction heaters for annealing and galvanizing lines in place of fired furnaces.

label: Electric smelting furnace for DRI
trl-basis: assessed (NeoSmelt pilot study 2025-26; the furnace type is commercial in ferroalloys)
description: Melts DRI made from lower-grade ore into hot metal for a BOF, removing gangue as slag.

label: Pellet induration (straight-grate, grate-kiln)
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I02; Hasanbeigi 2013; doe_2015_001
description: Hardens green pellets on a travelling grate or grate-kiln.
note: Most Canadian pelletizing is at the mines; see mining pelletizing. Merged pellet-plant_straight-grate (Straight-grate induration) 2026-09-23; it had family mining. Merged pellet-plant_grate-kiln (Grate-kiln induration) 2026-09-23; it had family mining.

label: Plasma or electric induration
description: Replaces the burner with plasma torches or electric heating in the induration furnace.

label: Acid pickling line
description: Removes scale in hydrochloric or sulphuric acid, with acid regeneration.

label: Ladle preheating
description: Gas burners drying and preheating ladle refractory; oxy-fuel and electric units are the alternatives.

label: Fluidized-bed direct reduction
trl-basis: assessed (Primetals HYFOR pilot; Circored operated commercially)
description: Reduces ore fines directly, skipping pelletizing.

label: Steel off-gases to chemicals and fuels
description: Converts blast-furnace and coke-oven gases to methanol, ammonia or other chemicals (e.g. Carbon2Chem), using the carbon instead of emitting it.
note: A utilisation alternative to capture on the steel mill's concentrated off-gas. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Cold rolling mill
description: Tandem or reversing mill reducing strip thickness cold.

label: Coupled pickling and tandem cold mill
description: Pickling line and tandem mill joined in one continuous line, avoiding re-coiling and re-heating.

label: Hot rolling mill
description: Roughing and finishing stands, plus section, bar, rod and tube mills.

label: Hot charging and direct rolling
description: Charges hot semis straight from casting, avoiding full reheating.

label: Hot rolling mill efficiency measures, moderate
description: Mill-side measures cutting rolling power and reheat losses.
examples-named: coil box; endless rolling; automatic gauge and flatness control; mill lubrication systems
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Thin-slab casting with direct rolling
description: Casts a thin slab and rolls it hot in line, cutting reheating and rolling passes.

label: Shaft-furnace direct reduction
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA 2019f; IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; IEA 2020; ETSAP I02; Hasanbeigi 2013; Asia 2010; Hasanbeigi 2014; doe_2015_001
description: Reduces pellets in a shaft with reformed gas or hydrogen, giving solid DRI for an EAF.
examples-named: MIDREX; Energiron; ArcelorMittal Contrecoeur; Dofasco Energiron ZR project (2.5 Mt/yr, announced); HYBRIT; Stegra

label: Gas-based direct reduction with capture on the CO2 removal unit
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; IEA 2020; Hasanbeigi 2013; Asia 2010
description: A gas-based DRI plant already strips CO2 from the recycled top gas, so capture is dehydration and compression on a nearly pure stream.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. The reformer and heater flue gas is a separate, dilute stream.

label: Electrolytic-hydrogen direct reduction with EAF (whole plant)
sources: Philibert 2017a; Vogl et al 2018; IEA 2020; Humbert et al 2024
description: Electrolysers, a hydrogen shaft furnace and an electric arc furnace together, per tonne of steel.
note: Whole-route alternative to shaft-furnace_direct-reduction plus electric-arc-furnace; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Sinter plant efficiency measures, moderate
description: Charging, bed and sealing measures on an existing sinter strand.
examples-named: improved charging; increased bed depth; reduced air leakage; ignition-hood control
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Sinter plant efficiency measures, strong
description: Recirculating part of the waste gas and recovering cooler heat.
examples-named: waste-gas recirculation (EPOSINT, EOS); sinter-cooler exhaust gas heat recovery
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Sinter strand
sources: Bataille 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I02; Hasanbeigi 2013; Worrell 2010; US 2012; doe_2015_001
description: Travelling-grate strand fusing ore fines, fluxes and coke breeze into sinter.

label: Bath smelting reduction
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; ETSAP I02; Hasanbeigi 2013; Hasanbeigi 2014
description: Smelts coal and ore fines in one vessel, with no coke ovens or sinter plant; off-gas is CO2-rich.
examples-named: HIsarna pilot at Tata Steel IJmuiden (60 kt/yr)
note: Oxygen blowing concentrates the off-gas, so capture sits on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated rather than the dilute plant a blast furnace needs.

label: Bath smelting reduction with capture
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; IEA 2020; Hasanbeigi 2013
description: Bath smelting reduction (HIsarna) with its oxygen-blown, CO2-rich off-gas dried, compressed and stored.
examples-named: HIsarna with CCS (UKERC IS-IW, IPCC Table 11.3)
note: Split from the plant without capture: capture roughly doubles its cost.

label: Low-shaft smelting reduction (Tecnored)
description: A single low-shaft furnace smelting cold-bonded self-reducing pellets or briquettes with fine coal or biomass and a hot air blast, without coke ovens or sinter.
note: Not two-stage smelting reduction (Corex/Finex has a separate pre-reduction shaft and oxygen-blown melter-gasifier). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Two-stage smelting reduction
description: Pre-reduction shaft plus a melter-gasifier running on coal, avoiding coke ovens.
note: No Canadian stock.

label: Two-stage smelting reduction with capture
description: COREX-type two-stage smelting reduction with CO2 removed from the export gas and stored.
note: Split from the plant without capture: capture roughly doubles its cost.

label: Fluorescent or high-intensity discharge lighting
applies-to: chemicals.service.lighting; coal-mining.service.lighting; industrial-minerals.service.lighting; iron-and-steel.service.lighting; light-industrial.service.lighting; metal-smelting.service.lighting; mining.service.lighting; petroleum-refining.service.lighting; pulp-and-paper.service.lighting
description: The incumbent industrial lighting stock.

label: LED lighting with controls
applies-to: chemicals.service.lighting; coal-mining.service.lighting; industrial-minerals.service.lighting; iron-and-steel.service.lighting; light-industrial.service.lighting; metal-smelting.service.lighting; mining.service.lighting; petroleum-refining.service.lighting; pulp-and-paper.service.lighting
description: Solid-state lighting with occupancy and daylight controls.

label: Gas engine or gas turbine drive
description: Engine or turbine driving a compressor or pump directly.

label: Turbine or engine drive efficiency measures, moderate
description: Driver upgrades and staging on gas-driven compression and pumping.
examples-named: high-efficiency gas-turbine drives; lean-burn engine retrofit; driver right-sizing and staging
note: [pumps] Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Compressed-air system management
description: Leak management, pressure reduction and sequencing across the compressor house.
examples-named: leak surveys; pressure optimization; sequencing controls; heat recovery

label: Conveying in place of truck haulage
description: Fixed conveying and hoisting replacing engine-driven movement of solids.
examples-named: in-pit crushing and conveying; overland conveyors

label: Fan system optimization
description: High-efficiency fan selection with duct and damper changes.
examples-named: airfoil fans; damper-to-VSD conversion; duct resizing

label: Induction motor, standard efficiency
description: IE2-IE3 squirrel-cage motor driving a pump, fan or compressor.

label: Premium-efficiency motor
description: IE4-IE5 motor, including permanent-magnet and synchronous-reluctance designs.

label: Variable-speed drive
description: Matches motor speed to load instead of throttling.
note: [pumps] CIMS carries the drive as its own `Direct Drive` service in seven sectors; the hierarchy folds it in here as a variant of the motor.

label: Pump system optimization
description: Right-sizing, impeller trimming and control changes on the pump system rather than the pump.
examples-named: impeller trimming; parallel staging; control-valve removal

label: Steam turbine drive
description: Back-pressure turbine driving a large compressor or pump.

label: Direct lithium extraction
description: Sorbents or membranes recover lithium from brine without evaporation ponds.

label: In-pit crushing and conveying
description: Crushes at the face and conveys ore out, replacing truck haulage.

label: Electric or heat-pump mine air heating
description: Electric heaters, or heat pumps on mine water or exhaust air.

label: Fixed-flow ventilation with direct-fired air heater
description: Main fans at constant flow, with a gas or propane mine air heater.

label: Froth flotation
description: Reagents and air separate value minerals from gangue in flotation cells.

label: Potash crystallization and flotation
description: Separates potash by flotation, or crystallizes it from hot brine.

label: SAG and ball mill circuit
description: Semi-autogenous grinding followed by ball milling, the standard hard-rock circuit.

label: Stirred fine grinding mills
description: Vertical or horizontal stirred mills for fine and regrind duties.

label: Battery-electric haulage
description: Battery trucks and loaders with fast charging or battery swap.

label: Diesel haul truck fleet
description: Diesel trucks, loaders and drills moving ore and waste.
note: Merged haul-truck_truck-and-shovel (Truck-and-shovel mining) 2026-09-23; it had family oil-and-gas, product-unit m3.

label: Hydrogen fuel-cell haulage
description: Fuel-cell trucks in demonstration at mine scale.

label: Trolley-assist haulage
description: Overhead catenary powers trucks on the ramp, cutting diesel on the loaded climb.

label: Exhaust-air heat recovery
description: Glycol loops or ice-stope storage recovering heat from exhaust air.

label: Shaft hoisting
description: Hoists lifting ore from depth in place of ramp haulage.

label: Bioleaching
description: Bacteria oxidize sulphides at low temperature in heaps or tanks.

label: Heap or atmospheric leaching with SX-EW
description: Leaches metal into solution, then solvent extraction and electrowinning.
note: Merged electrolysis-cell_sx-ew (Atmospheric leaching with solvent extraction and electrowinning) 2026-09-23; it had family non-ferrous-metals.

label: High-pressure acid leaching
description: Autoclave leaching of laterite and refractory ores.

label: In-situ leaching
description: Leaches the orebody in place, with no mining or milling.

label: Open-pit coal mine (whole mine)
description: Surface coal mine: overburden removal, extraction and haulage, with its dewatering and site services.
note: Whole-mine archetype: an alternative to the haulage and machine-drive archetypes within it. Separate from metal mines because coal releases seam methane (ETSAP P07/08: 0.3-2.0 m3/t in surface mining). Added 2026-09-23.

label: Underground coal mine (whole mine)
description: Room-and-pillar or longwall coal mine with its ventilation, hoisting and dewatering.
note: Whole-mine archetype. Seam methane is an order of magnitude above surface mining (ETSAP P07/08: 10-25 m3/t). Added 2026-09-23.

label: Underground battery-electric equipment
description: Battery LHDs, trucks and drills, which also cut ventilation demand.

label: Induration with cooler heat recovery
description: Returns cooling-zone heat to drying and preheating zones.

label: Mechanical dewatering before drying
description: Filters and centrifuges removing water mechanically instead of thermally.

label: Coal-mine methane drainage and use
description: Boreholes drain seam methane ahead of and behind mining; the gas is used in engines or flared instead of vented.
note: A methane control on the coal-mine archetypes. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Mine dewatering pumping
description: Pumping groundwater and surface water out of the pit or workings, and to treatment or discharge.
note: Runs on the site water balance, not on ore throughput.

label: Gravity and magnetic separation
description: Density and magnetic separation for iron ore and heavy minerals.

label: Mine water treatment plant
description: Lime treatment, settling and polishing before discharge.

label: Sensor-based ore sorting
description: Rejects waste rock before milling, cutting the tonnes ground.

label: Reverse osmosis and evaporative concentration
description: Membrane or thermal concentration where the discharge permit needs it, at much higher energy per cubic metre.

label: Tailings thickening and water reclaim
description: Thickeners and reclaim barges returning process water to the mill.

label: Thickening and filtration
description: Dewaters concentrate and tailings before drying or disposal.

label: Battery-electric equipment
description: Battery drive for forklifts, loaders and excavators.

label: Diesel non-road equipment
description: Loaders, forklifts, yard trucks and construction equipment on diesel engines.

label: Diesel-electric hybrid equipment
description: Series or parallel hybrid drive recovering braking and smoothing engine load.

label: Propane or natural gas forklift
description: Spark-ignition industrial truck.

label: Hydrogen fuel-cell equipment
description: Fuel-cell drive, commercial in forklifts and in demonstration for heavy equipment.
note: TRL spans the two classes of equipment.

label: Gas-suspension calciner
description: Suspension calcination of hydrate, at lower fuel use than a rotary calciner.

label: Continuous converting
description: Continuous flash or bath converting, cutting fugitive losses and fuel per tonne.

label: Peirce-Smith converting
description: Batch converting of matte to blister metal.

label: Bayer digestion on fossil steam
description: Caustic digestion of bauxite under pressure, with steam from gas or oil boilers.

label: Biomass-fired Bayer heat
description: Biomass replaces a high share of the fossil fuel raising digestion steam.

label: Electrified Bayer heat
description: Electric boilers or heaters supply digestion heat.

label: Hydrogen in the Bayer process
description: Hydrogen firing for digestion and calcination heat.

label: Bayer alumina refining with CO2 capture
description: An alumina refinery whose calciner or boiler flue gas carries CO2 capture.
note: Holds host-side facts on the alumina node; the capture plant is a capture-unit_* archetype on metal-smelting.service.ccs.diffuse (node added 2026-09-26). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Hydrogen-fired ancillary heat
description: Hydrogen burners on holding, roasting and refining furnaces.

label: Open-arc DC furnace
description: Direct-current open arc, taking finer feed and a wider reductant range.

label: Submerged-arc furnace
description: Electrodes buried in the charge, smelting silicon, ferroalloys or titanium slag.

label: Electrowinning with advanced anodes and energy control
description: Lower-overpotential anodes and current control cutting cell power.

label: Hydro- or electrolytic non-ferrous smelting
description: Leaching and electrowinning, or direct electrolysis, in place of fuel-fired pyrometallurgical smelting of non-ferrous ores.
note: IPCC gives up to 99% reduction and an ore-specific cost. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Inert anode cell
sources: IPCC 2022; MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I10
description: Non-consumable anodes give oxygen instead of CO2 at the anode.

label: Multipolar or chloride cell
description: Cell geometry or chloride chemistry cutting cell voltage and footprint.

label: Smelter power modulation
description: Controlled amperage swings let the potline follow the grid without losing production.

label: Prebaked anode cell
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I10; doe_2017_001
description: Centre-worked prebake Hall-Heroult cells with point feeding.

label: Prebaked anode cell with CO2 capture
description: An aluminium smelter capturing the dilute CO2 in potline off-gas.
note: Holds host-side facts on the electrolysis node; the capture plant is a capture-unit_* archetype on metal-smelting.service.ccs.diffuse (node added 2026-09-26). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Soderberg cell
description: Self-baking anode cells, the older Canadian stock.

label: Prebake anode baking furnace
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I10; doe_2017_001
description: Open or closed ring furnace baking green anodes.

label: Electrified or hydrogen-fired anode baking
description: Electric or hydrogen heat replaces the fossil burner on the baking furnace.

label: Homogenizing and reheat furnaces
description: Heat treatment of billets and slabs before extrusion or rolling.

label: Twin-chamber furnace with decoating
description: Burns off coatings and melts in separate chambers, raising recovery and cutting fuel.

label: Off-gas energy recovery
description: Recovers CO-rich furnace gas as fuel or power.

label: Regenerative or oxy-fuel melting
description: Air preheat or oxygen firing cutting melting fuel per tonne.

label: Reverberatory or rotary melting furnace
sources: MIDDEN database v0.4a; ETSAP I10; doe_2017_001
description: Gas-fired melting of ingot, scrap and returns before casting.

label: Soderberg paste plant
description: Mixes and pastes anode material for self-baking cells.

label: Bio-pitch and bio-coke anodes
description: Biogenic binder and filler replacing fossil pitch and petroleum coke.

label: Biocarbon reductant
description: Charcoal or biocoke replaces fossil carbon in the charge.

label: Pre-reduction of feed
description: Reduces the ore before smelting, cutting furnace electricity per tonne.

label: Continuous casting and rolling
description: Casts and rolls in one line, avoiding a reheating step.

label: Ring rolling with variable wall thickness
description: Rolls rings with varying wall thickness close to final shape, cutting material and machining.
note: The hierarchy has no non-ferrous rolling node; linked to melting, casting and fabrication. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Smelting efficiency measures, moderate
description: Incremental measures on an existing smelter off-gas and feed system.
examples-named: feed drying with off-gas heat; improved hooding; oxygen control
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Smelting efficiency measures, strong
description: Higher oxygen enrichment with a waste-heat boiler on the off-gas.
examples-named: higher oxygen enrichment; waste-heat boiler on the off-gas; off-gas heat to feed drying
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Flash smelting furnace
description: Oxygen-enriched flash smelting of sulphide concentrate, with a waste-heat boiler.

label: Top-submerged-lance bath smelting
description: Bath smelting with a submerged lance, for concentrates and secondary feed.

label: Solar thermal in the Bayer process
description: Concentrating solar raises part of the digestion heat.

label: Flash or fluid-bed calciner
description: Short residence time in suspension or a fluidized bed, with better heat transfer.

label: Electric or heat-pump dryer
description: Electric air heating, or a heat pump where the duty is below about 150 degC.

label: Kiln waste-heat drying
description: Uses kiln or cooler exhaust to dry raw materials and additions.
note: product-unit GJ: most of its sources price it per GJ (its end use is measured in t product).

label: Direct-fired rotary or fluid-bed dryer or calciner
description: Hot gas in direct contact with the mineral, for drying and gypsum calcining.
note: Merged dryer_rotary-fluid-bed (Direct-fired rotary or fluid-bed dryer) 2026-09-23; it had family mining.

label: Hybrid furnace with electric boosting
description: Fuel firing with electrode boosting, raising pull and cutting fuel per tonne.

label: Oxy-fuel glass furnace
description: Fires on oxygen, cutting flue-gas volume and fuel use.

label: Air-fuel regenerative glass furnace
description: Cross- or end-fired furnace with regenerators preheating combustion air.

label: Glass tempering furnace
description: Heats flat glass to about 620 degC and quenches it with air jets.

label: Hydrogen-fired furnace
description: Burners fired on hydrogen for high-temperature melting or firing.

label: Gas-fired annealing lehr
description: Conveyor oven that reheats formed glass and cools it slowly to relieve stress.

label: Electric annealing lehr
description: Resistance-heated lehr doing the same duty on electricity.

label: Electric kiln
description: Resistance-heated kiln for ceramics and technical products.

label: Hydrogen-fired kiln
description: Kiln burners fired on hydrogen for high-temperature firing.

label: Dolomitic lime kiln
description: Calcines dolomite to dolomitic lime.

label: Oxy-fuel lime kiln
description: Fires on oxygen and recycled gas so the kiln gas is CO2-rich.
note: Oxy-firing concentrates the stream: capture sits on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated.

label: Parallel-flow regenerative shaft kiln
description: Two shafts alternate firing and preheating, cutting fuel use well below a rotary kiln.

label: Rotary lime kiln with preheater
description: Rotating kiln calcining limestone, with a preheater and product cooler.

label: Lime kiln with post-combustion capture
description: Capture on the lime kiln stack. Two thirds of the CO2 is process CO2 off the limestone, which no fuel switch can reach.
note: [lime-calcination] Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. A lime kiln has no waste heat to spare for regeneration, so the capture plant needs its own heat source - that is the host-side fact this row carries. [lime-kiln] Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. Small beside the recovery boiler, but on the same steam balance.

label: Tunnel or roller kiln
description: Continuous kiln firing brick, tile and refractories.

label: Electric melter
description: All-electric cold-top furnace melting the batch with immersed electrodes.

label: Molecular-sieve dehydration
description: Adsorbent beds regenerated with hot gas, to cryogenic-plant dryness.

label: Direct contact steam generation
description: Burns fuel in the water stream, producing steam and CO2 together for injection.

label: Once-through field boiler
description: Field boiler raising 75-80% quality steam from treated produced water; known in the field as a once-through steam generator (OTSG).

label: Electric-motor-driven refrigeration
description: Large motors drive the compressors, moving the emissions to the grid.

label: Gas-turbine-driven refrigeration
description: Aero-derivative or heavy-duty turbines driving the refrigerant compressors.

label: High-efficiency gas-turbine drive
description: Later turbine vintages with higher simple-cycle efficiency.

label: Blowdown gas recompression
description: Recompresses depressurization gas into the line instead of venting it before maintenance.
examples-named: portable recompression units; pressurized pipeline transfer
note: The harmonized `capture-unit` entry for this service is filed as CO2 capture; it is methane recovery.

label: Boil-off gas recovery
description: Recompresses boil-off gas back into the process instead of flaring or fuelling.

label: Dry gas seals on centrifugal compressors
description: Replaces wet seals, whose degassing vents methane continuously, on centrifugal compressors.
examples-named: dry gas seal retrofits; seal gas recovery on wet seals
note: Wet-seal degassing is one of the largest single fugitive sources at a compressor station.

label: Efficient reciprocating compressor
description: Newer engine and compressor with lower fuel use per unit of compression.

label: Electric-drive compressor
description: Large motors driving centrifugal compressors on grid power.

label: Electric-drive compression
description: Motor-driven reciprocating compressors in place of gas engines.

label: Flare gas recovery
description: Compresses gas that would be flared back into the fuel or sales line.

label: Reciprocating gas-engine compressor
description: Engine-driven reciprocating compressors, common on gathering systems and at gas plants.

label: Gas-turbine compressor station
description: Gas turbines driving centrifugal compressors, burning pipeline or fuel gas.

label: Instrument air or electric actuation
description: Compressed air or electric actuators and pumps replace gas-driven devices.

label: Vapour recovery unit
description: Compresses tank and process vapours back into the sales line.

label: Fired line heater and treater
description: Burner heating produced fluids to break emulsions and prevent hydrates.

label: Battery hybrid rig power
description: Battery smooths engine load, cutting fuel and run hours.

label: Diesel drilling rig
description: Diesel-electric rig powering the drawworks, mud pumps and camp.

label: Grid-powered or electric rig
description: Rig drawing from the grid or a field electrical system.

label: Evaporators and crystallizers
description: Mechanical vapour recompression evaporators producing distilled makeup and a small residual for disposal.

label: Flare with continuous pilot
description: Elevated flare burning solution and process gas that is not captured; the incumbent disposal route.

label: Enclosed combustor
description: Enclosed burner destroying tank and process vapours that would otherwise be vented.
note: Destroys vented gas, so release and destruction compete inside this end use.

label: High-efficiency flare
description: Air-assisted or improved flare tips raising destruction efficiency and cutting unburnt methane.
note: Abates the methane slip from an ordinary flare, not the flaring itself.

label: Electric fracturing fleet
description: Electric pumps on grid or turbine power replace diesel pump spreads.

label: Amine sweetening
description: Amine absorption removing H2S and CO2, with a steam-heated regenerator.

label: Acid gas removal with CO2 compression and injection
trl-basis: commercial; Alberta acid gas injection schemes
description: The amine unit already separates CO2 along with the H2S, so capture is compression, dehydration and injection instead of venting.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. Reservoir CO2 separated here is the cheapest capture in the database and should not be averaged with flue-gas capture.

label: Claus sulphur recovery
description: Converts H2S to elemental sulphur, with tail-gas treating.

label: Glycol dehydration
description: TEG contactor with a fired reboiler regenerating the glycol.

label: Coal gasification with methanation (SNG)
description: Gasifies coal to syngas and methanates it to substitute natural gas.
note: Linked provisionally to gas processing; a synthetic-fuels node is requested in docs/hierarchy-change-requests.md. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Coal-to-liquids (gasification and Fischer-Tropsch)
description: Gasifies coal and converts the syngas to liquid fuels by Fischer-Tropsch synthesis.
note: Fossil counterpart of gasifier_fischer-tropsch (biomass and waste); split because its emissions differ in kind. Linked provisionally; a synthetic-fuels node is requested. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Electric or autonomous haul fleet
description: Battery or trolley trucks, often with autonomous haulage control.

label: Electric or heat-pump treating
description: Electric heaters, or heat pumps, on low-temperature treating duties.

label: Compressor-station waste-heat power
description: Organic Rankine cycle on turbine exhaust generating station power.

label: Turbine waste-heat recovery
description: Recovers turbine exhaust heat for process and utility duties.

label: Small-scale or modular liquefaction
description: Modular trains for peak shaving and remote supply.

label: Leak detection and repair
description: Scheduled surveys finding and fixing leaking components.
examples-named: optical gas imaging surveys; Method 21 screening
note: Frequency is what sets the abatement; an annual program and a quarterly one are different technologies in practice.

label: Continuous methane monitoring
trl-basis: assessed; commercial deployments on production sites
description: Fixed sensors, or aerial and satellite screening, finding leaks between surveys; it also catches vent events, but it substitutes for survey frequency, which is why it sits here.
examples-named: site sensor networks; aerial and satellite screening

label: Electric motor in place of a field engine
description: Grid or site power replacing the engine; needs a power line or a site microgrid.

label: Gas-driven pneumatic controllers and pumps
description: Well-site instruments and chemical-injection pumps driven by pipeline gas, which vent methane.

label: Drag-reducing agents
description: Polymer injection cuts friction, raising throughput per unit of pumping power.

label: Low-emission valves and connectors
description: Bellows-sealed and low-leak valve and connector designs cutting the leak rate of new and replaced components.
examples-named: bellows-sealed valves; low-e packing; welded connections

label: Electric artificial lift
description: Beam pumps, progressive-cavity and electric submersible pumps on motors.

label: Electric pump station
description: Motor-driven mainline pumps moving crude and products.

label: Plunger lift and smart liquids unloading
description: Unloads liquids without blowing the well down to atmosphere.

label: Variable-speed pump drives
description: Speed control replaces throttling and station cycling.

label: Ebullated-bed hydrocracking
description: Hydrogen addition in a moving catalyst bed for high conversion of residue.

label: Fluid or flexi-coking
description: Fluidized thermal cracking, with the coke partly gasified for fuel gas.

label: Gas-to-liquids (reforming and Fischer-Tropsch)
