description: Reforms natural gas to syngas and converts it to liquid fuels by Fischer-Tropsch synthesis.
note: Linked provisionally; a synthetic-fuels node is requested. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Fixed-bed hydrotreating
description: Hydrogen treating to remove sulphur and stabilize synthetic crude.

label: Integrated bitumen upgrader (whole plant)
description: A whole upgrader turning bitumen into synthetic crude: coking or hydrocracking, hydrotreating, hydrogen supply and utilities together.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes (reactor_fluid-coking, reactor_delayed-coking, reactor_ebullated-bed-hydrocracking, reactor_hydrotreating-fixed-bed); do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Integrated bitumen upgrader with capture (whole plant)
description: A whole upgrader with CO2 captured from the concentrated hydrogen-plant or gasifier stream.
examples-named: North West Redwater (Sturgeon); Quest at Scotford
note: Holds host-side facts; the capture plant is capture-unit_* on the ccs.concentrated node. Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Nuclear steam supply
description: Small modular reactor raising steam for injection.

label: Partial upgrading
description: Field-scale treatment that meets pipeline specification without full upgrading.

label: Diesel field engine
description: Stationary diesel engine driving pumps, generators and other well-site equipment.

label: Dual-fuel or natural-gas engines
description: Field or well gas displaces part of the diesel in rig and pump engines.

label: Gasoline or propane field engine
description: Small spark-ignition engine on gasoline or propane at remote sites.

label: Gas-engine driven pumps
description: Engine-driven pumps on lines without grid supply.

label: Thickened, paste or dry-stack tailings
description: Dewaters tailings mechanically, cutting pond volume and recycled-water heating.
note: Merged separator_paste-tailings (Paste and dry-stack tailings) 2026-09-23; it had family mining, type alternative, trl 9, product-unit GJ.

label: Non-aqueous extraction
description: Solvent-based extraction without hot water, cutting heat and tailings.

label: Paraffinic froth treatment
description: Paraffinic solvent rejects asphaltenes, giving a cleaner bitumen product.

label: Produced water recycling for makeup
description: Treats and reuses produced and flowback water as fracturing or steam makeup instead of disposing of it.
note: Cuts both disposal energy and freshwater draw.

label: De-oiling and warm lime softening
description: Skim tanks, induced gas flotation and warm lime softening conditioning produced water for steam generation.
note: The water plant is part of what sets the steam-to-oil ratio.

label: Hydrotransport and warm-water extraction
description: Slurries ore in warm water, separating bitumen froth in gravity vessels.

label: Turboexpander NGL recovery
description: Expansion refrigeration recovering ethane and heavier liquids.

label: Turboexpander at pressure let-down
description: Recovers pressure energy as power instead of throttling, with line heating.

label: Cyclic steam stimulation (CSS)
description: One well alternately injects steam, soaks and produces heated bitumen. The whole recovery process, its steam generation included.
note: As well_sagd; the steam-to-oil ratio is typically higher (ETSAP P02: 3.4 against 3.2). Sources abbreviate it CSS and ETSAP P02 misprints it 'CCS'. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Disposal well injection
description: Pumps produced and flowback water to a disposal formation.

label: Steam-assisted gravity drainage (SAGD)
description: Paired horizontal wells: steam injected in the upper well drains heated bitumen to the lower producer. The whole recovery process, its steam generation included.
note: Whole-process archetype for in-situ recovery; boiler_once-through and boiler_direct-contact are the steam-generation equipment within it, so do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Solvent-assisted steam recovery
description: Co-injects a solvent with steam, cutting the steam-to-oil ratio.

label: Solvent-only extraction
description: Dissolves bitumen with solvent and little or no steam.

label: Oxy-fuel supercritical-CO2 power cycle
description: A natural-gas cycle burning in oxygen with supercritical CO2 as working fluid, delivering CO2 ready for storage (Allam cycle).

label: Gas engine or simple-cycle gas turbine
description: Gas-fired generator without heat recovery.

label: Generating set efficiency measures, moderate
description: Raising the electrical efficiency of an existing on-site set.
examples-named: combined-cycle conversion of a simple-cycle set; lean-burn engine upgrade; turbine inlet cooling
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column.

label: Geothermal binary-cycle power
description: A binary (organic Rankine) cycle generating power from moderate-temperature geothermal brine.
note: Relevant to co-produced brines at oil and gas fields. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Solar PV with battery storage
description: Site-scale PV and storage displacing genset fuel.

label: Microreactor
description: Factory-built heat-pipe reactor sized for a remote site.

label: Diesel generator set
description: Reciprocating diesel generator, the standard off-grid supply.

label: Condensing steam turbine
carriers: biomass; steam; coal; oil; natural-gas; by-product-gas
description: Boiler and condensing turbine producing power only.
examples-named: steelworks power plants firing coke-oven gas

label: Waste-heat power (ORC or steam Rankine)
description: Converts exhaust or process heat to electricity.
examples-named: ORC on kiln and compressor exhaust

label: Wind turbines at site
description: Site wind generation, usually with storage, at remote operations.

label: Direct-fired dryer or curing oven
carriers: natural-gas; biogas; hydrogen; liquid-biomass; lpg; oil
description: Gas-fired ovens for paint curing, textile finishing and product drying.
note: product-unit GJ: most of its sources price it per GJ (its end use is measured in t product).

label: Direct-fired dryer efficiency measures, moderate
description: The direct-fired dryer or curing oven with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on dryer_direct-fired.

label: Direct-fired dryer efficiency measures, strong
carriers: natural-gas; biogas; electricity; hydrogen; liquid-biomass; lpg; oil
description: The direct-fired dryer or curing oven with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for the UK TIMES advanced drying option.

label: Solid-fuel dryer
description: A direct-fired dryer burning coal, coke, biomass or coal tars.
note: Split from the gas- and liquid-fired dryer: UK TIMES costs solid-fuel units at 5-10 times the gas-fired unit. Coal tars are grouped here because UK TIMES costs them as coal.

label: Solid-fuel dryer efficiency measures, strong
description: The solid-fuel dryer with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23, split from dryer_direct-fired_efficiency-strong by fuel handling.

label: Direct-fired veneer and strand dryer
description: Hot gas from a burner or boiler drying veneer, strands and particles.

label: Fuel-fired heat-treatment furnace
description: Batch and continuous furnaces for annealing, normalizing and forging heat.

label: Regenerative or recuperative burners
description: Air preheat on melting and heat-treatment furnaces.

label: Electric or induction heat treatment
description: Resistance or induction heating for hardening, forging and annealing.

label: Continuous kiln with heat recovery
description: Continuous drying with zone heat recovery, at lower energy per cubic metre.

label: Dehumidification or heat-pump kiln
description: Heat-pump kiln recovering latent heat from the drying air.

label: Steam or thermal-oil lumber kiln
description: Batch kilns heated by hog-fuel boilers through steam or thermal oil.

label: Cupola or gas-fired melting furnace
description: Coke cupola or gas-fired furnace melting iron and non-ferrous metal in foundries.
note: product-unit GJ: most of its sources price it per GJ (its end use is measured in t product).

label: Electric arc melting furnace
description: Arc melting for steel and iron castings.

label: Induction melting and holding furnace
applies-to: metal-smelting.product.aluminum.recycle; metal-smelting.product.copper.melt-cast; metal-smelting.product.lead.melt-cast; metal-smelting.product.magnesium.melt-cast; metal-smelting.product.nickel.melt-cast; metal-smelting.product.zinc.melt-cast; iron-and-steel.product.foundry; light-industrial.service.heat
description: Coreless or channel induction melting, common in modern foundries.
note: Merged induction-heater_melting-holding (Induction melting and holding) 2026-09-23; it had family non-ferrous-metals.

label: Wood pellet mill
description: Dries, grinds and presses sawdust, shavings or chips into fuel pellets.
note: Not the iron-ore pellet-plant archetypes. Drying heat is usually from burning part of the residue. Added 2026-09-23.

label: All-electric injection moulding and extrusion
description: Servo-electric machines replacing hydraulic drives, with electric barrel heating.

label: Hot press with thermal-oil heater
description: Heated platens curing resin in plywood, OSB and MDF panels.

label: Biomass torrefaction and pelletising
trl-basis: etsap_2013_010 (pilot and first commercial plants in 2013)
description: Roasts biomass at 250-300 degC without oxygen before pelletising, giving a denser, water-resistant fuel.

label: Infrared or ultraviolet curing
description: Radiant or photochemical curing in place of hot-air ovens.

label: Autothermal reformer
sources: UKERC 2013; IEA 2019f; IEA ETP Guide 2024; Moore 2017; MIDDEN database v0.4a
description: Partial oxidation with oxygen in one vessel; suits high capture rates.
examples-named: Air Products Alberta net-zero hydrogen complex (Edmonton)
note: [refinery-hydrogen] Commercial for syngas; the IEA TRL is for the CCUS-enabled hydrogen configuration. product-unit t: most of its sources price it per t (its end use is measured in GJ).

label: Electrified crude heater
description: Electric resistance or rotodynamic heating replaces the fired crude heater.

label: Atmospheric and vacuum distillation with fired heaters
description: Crude heated in fired heaters and fractionated at atmospheric pressure, then under vacuum.

label: Water electrolysis, low temperature
sources: Armijo and Philibert 2020; IEA 2018a; IEA 2019f; IEA ETP Guide 2024; IPCC 2022; Moore 2017; Philibert 2017a; MIDDEN database v0.4a; Vogl et al 2018; DEA 2026 renewable fuels; Kuparinen and Vakkilainen 2017; Layritz et al 2021; etsap_2014_003; iea_2021_001
description: Alkaline or PEM stacks splitting water with electricity.

label: Advanced acid gas removal
description: Selective solvents or membranes cutting regeneration energy.

label: Sulphur recovery and acid gas removal
description: Amine treating plus a Claus unit and tail-gas treatment.

label: Coal or petroleum-coke gasification
description: Partial oxidation of solid feed to syngas, then shift.

label: Advanced heat integration
description: Pinch-designed preheat train and better fouling control, cutting furnace duty.

label: Alkylation and isomerization
description: Combines or rearranges light ends into high-octane blendstock.

label: Catalytic reforming
description: Upgrades naphtha to high-octane reformate, producing hydrogen.

label: Delayed coking
description: Thermally cracks residue to lighter products and petroleum coke.

label: Fluid catalytic cracking
description: Cracks gas oil over a circulating catalyst; coke burnt off in the regenerator supplies the heat.

label: Oxy-fuel FCC regeneration
description: Burns catalyst coke in oxygen so the regenerator flue gas is CO2-rich.
note: Oxy-firing the regenerator concentrates the stream: capture sits on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated.

label: FCC regenerator with post-combustion capture
description: Capture on the catalytic cracker regenerator flue gas, the largest single stack in a refinery.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. Oxy-fuel regeneration is its own row and gives a concentrated stream.

label: Hydroprocessing (hydrocracking and hydrotreating)
description: Hydrogen-driven cracking and sulphur or nitrogen removal at pressure.

label: Conversion (cracking) refinery (whole plant)
description: A hydroskimming refinery with catalytic cracking or hydrocracking.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Deep-conversion (coking) refinery (whole plant)
description: A conversion refinery with coking or residue hydrocracking, able to run heavy crude and bitumen blends.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Hydroskimming refinery (whole plant)
description: Distillation, reforming and hydrotreating with no conversion units.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Reformer efficiency measures, moderate
description: Heat integration and feed conditioning on an existing reformer.
examples-named: pre-reforming; convection-section heat recovery; combustion-air preheat; hydrogen recovery from purge gas
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. product-unit t: most of its sources price it per t (its end use is measured in GJ).

label: Steam methane reformer
sources: IEA 2019f; IEA ETP Guide 2024; MIDDEN database v0.4a; doe_2015_004; doe_2022_001; etsap_2014_003
description: Reforms natural gas with steam, then shifts to hydrogen and CO2.

label: Steam methane reformer with capture on the shift gas
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 285 (partial capture); row 284 gives 6 for high capture rates
description: Capture on the shifted syngas, where the CO2 is already at high partial pressure. Taking the reformer flue gas as well needs a second, dilute-stream plant.
note: [refinery-hydrogen] Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. Partial capture takes only the shift gas and reaches about 60% of the plant total; full capture adds a diffuse-stream plant on the reformer flue gas.

label: Anaerobic treatment with biogas recovery
description: Anaerobic reactors on high-strength streams, cutting aeration load and recovering biogas as fuel.
note: Turns part of the treatment load into a fuel, which is why it is a technology choice rather than generic pumping.

label: Recovery boiler
description: Burns concentrated black liquor, recovering smelt and raising high-pressure steam.

label: High-solids firing and high-pressure recovery boiler
description: Higher liquor dry solids and steam conditions, raising power and steam yield.

label: Recovery boiler with post-combustion capture
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 422; row 501 gives 6 for post-combustion capture on biomass combustion
description: Capture on the recovery boiler stack. The CO2 is biogenic, so this is a removal rather than an avoided emission.
note: Dilute stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-diffuse. The mill steam balance is what binds, and that is the host-side fact this row carries.

label: Batch kraft digester with displacement heating
description: Batch cooking with hot-liquor displacement recovering most of the cooking heat.

label: Continuous kraft digester
description: Continuous vessel cooking chips in white liquor, with heat recovery from the flash steam.

label: Deep eutectic solvent pulping
description: Separates lignin from cellulose with deep eutectic solvents at low temperature and pressure instead of kraft cooking.

label: Semi-chemical and sulphite pulping
description: Milder chemical cooking for corrugating medium and specialty pulps.

label: Electric air heating
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: Electric heaters replace the gas burner on hoods and air dryers.

label: Gas-fired hood, infrared or air dryer
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: Direct-fired Yankee hoods, infrared and air dryers on tissue and coating.
note: product-unit GJ: most of its sources price it per GJ (its end use is measured in t water evaporated or t product).

label: Heat-pump drying
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: Heat pump upgrades dryer exhaust heat back into the drying air.

label: High-efficiency hood with heat recovery
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: Closed hood and air system recovering exhaust heat to the machine and mill.

label: Steam-heated cylinder dryer section
product: t water evaporated or t product
sources: UKERC 2013; Bataille 2017; IEA ETP Guide 2024; Fleiter 2012; Kong 2016; doe_2015_003
description: Steam-filled cans drying the web, with condensate return.

label: Paper dryer section efficiency measures, moderate
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: The steam-heated cylinder dryer section with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: reduced air infiltration, hood humidity, pressure and felt optimisation, condensate return, flash-steam use, low-pressure steam, heat recovery (UKERC PP-D1 to PP-D11)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on dryer_steam-heated.

label: Paper dryer section efficiency measures, strong
product: t water evaporated or t product
description: The steam-heated cylinder dryer section with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: hot press ahead of the dryer section (UKERC PP-D12)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on dryer_steam-heated.

label: Multiple-effect evaporators
description: Concentrates weak black liquor in a train of effects on live steam.

label: Activated sludge aeration
description: Surface aerators or coarse-bubble diffusers holding an aeration basin at the oxygen demand of the effluent.

label: Fine-bubble diffused aeration
description: Fine-bubble diffusers with blower control on dissolved oxygen, at a fraction of the power of surface aeration.

label: Black liquor gasification
sources: IEA ETP Guide 2024; ETSAP I07; Larson 2006; US 2010; Kong 2016; etsap_2013_007
description: Gasifies liquor to syngas for fuels, chemicals or a gas turbine, in place of a recovery boiler.

label: Electrified lime kiln
description: Plasma or electric heating of the calcination zone.

label: Biomass-gasifier-fired lime kiln
description: On-site gasifier supplies producer gas to the kiln burner in place of fossil fuel.

label: Lime kiln with product cooler and improved drying
description: Better cooler, chain section and mud drying, cutting fuel per tonne of lime.

label: Rotary lime kiln
description: Calcines lime mud back to lime for causticizing.

label: Fourdrinier or gap former with press section
description: Headbox, wire and press section dewatering the sheet mechanically.

label: Paper machine efficiency measures, moderate
description: The fourdrinier or gap former with press section with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: wire-section drainage and vacuum practice, felt and press steam optimisation, online moisture management (UKERC PP-W, PP-P3, PP-P7, PP-VWPD1)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for wire- and press-section measures.

label: Paper machine press section efficiency measures, strong
description: The fourdrinier or gap former with press section with incremental efficiency measures applied.
examples-named: steam boxes ahead of the press (UKERC PP-P2)
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on paper-machine_fourdrinier-gap.

label: Paper making without water
description: Forms paper by dry or foam forming, removing most of the water that the dryer section must evaporate.

label: Advanced mechanical dewatering
description: Impulse or pressurized dewatering removing more water before the dryers.

label: Shoe (extended-nip) press
description: Longer nip raises sheet dryness into the dryer section, cutting drying steam.

label: Drum debarker and disc chipper
description: A rotating drum strips bark by tumbling the logs; disc chippers cut them to chips for screening.

label: Log and chip thawing with recovered heat
description: Warm water or low-grade waste heat thaws frozen wood in place of live steam.

label: Chemi-thermomechanical pulping
description: Mild chemical pre-treatment before refining, at lower electricity per tonne.

label: Recycled-fibre repulping and deinking
sources: ETSAP I07; US 2010; Fleiter 2012; Kong 2016; Lipiainen 2022
description: Pulpers, screens and flotation cells recovering fibre from recovered paper.

label: Low-energy refining
description: Advanced segments, RTS conditions or pre-treatment cutting refiner electricity.

label: Thermomechanical pulping refiners
description: Steam-pressurized disc refiners fibrillating chips; refiner heat is recovered as steam.

label: Conventional ECF bleach plant
description: Elemental-chlorine-free bleaching sequence with chlorine dioxide stages, without oxygen delignification.
note: Conventional host for reactor_oxygen-delignification. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Oxygen delignification with ECF bleaching
description: Removes lignin with oxygen before bleaching, cutting chemical and steam use.

label: Clarification and sludge dewatering
description: Primary clarifiers with belt or screw presses, and dryers where the sludge is burnt.
note: product-unit t: most of its sources price it per t (its end use is measured in GJ).

label: Lignin extraction
sources: ETSAP I07; Kong 2016; Kuparinen and Vakkilainen 2017
description: Precipitates lignin from the liquor as a fuel or chemical feedstock, debottlenecking the boiler.

label: Mechanical vapour recompression evaporation
description: Recompresses vapour to drive the evaporator, replacing most live steam with electricity.

label: Chilled-water system
description: Central chiller serving air handlers through chilled water.

label: Packaged air conditioner or rooftop unit
description: Direct-expansion cooling with an air handler.

label: Free or evaporative cooling
description: Uses ambient air or evaporation before running the refrigeration cycle.

label: Constant-volume fan system
description: Supply and exhaust fans running at fixed flow.
note: Building ventilation.

label: Variable-speed fans
description: Fan speed follows the load instead of throttling or running flat out.
note: Building ventilation.

label: Reversible heat pump
description: One machine providing both building heat and cooling.

label: Space-heating heat pump
description: Air-source or ground-source heat pump for building heat and cooling.

label: Electric resistance space heating
description: Unit heaters and baseboards.

label: Fuel-fired space or make-up air heater
description: Unit heaters, radiant tubes and make-up air units firing gas.

label: Demand-controlled ventilation
description: Air flow set by occupancy or contaminant sensing.
note: Building ventilation. Merged ventilation-unit_mine-on-demand (Ventilation on demand) 2026-09-23; it had family mining.

label: Heat-recovery ventilation
description: Exhaust air preheats or precools the incoming supply air.
note: Building ventilation.
